Screening of an acquisition or investment: the transaction's context, its parties, financing and valuation inputs.

The concept behind it: [Mergers and acquisitions](@/glossary/mergers-and-acquisitions.md).

Services that draw on it: [M&A pre-deal screening and analysis](@/services/m-and-a.md).

Practised with: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md), [FastAPI](@/glossary/fastapi.md) and [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md).

It was applied in client work in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group; the use cases below give the principle and the intent, without names or numbers.
